Concept Description: Whether the participant is currently breastfeeding at the time of the visit or exam. Use for current breastfeeding status; not for lifetime breastfeeding history (months breastfed, number of children breastfed) or for how an infant is fed.

Reproductive stage of a woman at the time of the visit: premenopausal, perimenopausal or postmenopausal (natural or surgical). Use for the status itself; not for age at menopause, the cause of menopause, or hormone therapy. A yes/no item such as 'Have you reached menopause?' gives postmenopausal versus not-postmenopausal only; do not assign perimenopausal or surgical from it.
Example source variable description: [Menstrual history and pregnancies]. Have you reached menopause? Q7 [Reproductive History Form, RHXA. Visit 3]|Menopausal status [Cohort Visit Derived Variables. Visit 1]|Menopausal status at visit 1

Concept Description: Whether the participant has menstrual bleeding (menstruation), in the period the source question asks about, for example any menstrual periods in the past 2 years. Use for whether bleeding occurs; not for the date of the last period, age at first period, or menopause status.
Example source variable description: [Menstrual history and pregnancies]. Have you had any menstrual periods during the past 2 years? Q4 [Reproductive History Form, RHXA. Visit 3]|[Reproductive history]. Have you had any menstrual periods during the past 2 years? Q15 [Health/Medical History, HHXB. Visit 2]

Concept Description: Whether the participant is pregnant at the time of the visit or exam, by report or test. Use for current pregnancy; not for pregnancy history (ever pregnant, number of pregnancies or live births) or for the outcome of a pregnancy.
Example source variable description: PREGNANCY STATUS|CURRENTLY PREGNANT?|[Exclusion]. [For females only] Could you be pregnant? Q6 [MRI Screening Form, MSCA04. Visit 3]
